tasks.title: 注入 TimeProvider 与 WorkflowOptions，切换取用点时间读取（可测化前置重构）
tasks.spec: specs/workflow-supervision/spec.md#超时相关时间读取统一走 TimeProvider
tasks.description: Make RunnerGrain time-testable as a prerequisite refactor. Add a WorkflowOptions class (SectionName="Mohist:Workflow", TimeSpan WorkCompletionTimeout default 30min) registered via services.Configure<WorkflowOptions> in MohistServiceRegistration (mirroring AgentJobOptions). Inject TimeProvider and IOptions<WorkflowOptions> into RunnerGrain's constructor and switch the two work take points (PollOneWorkflowAsync ~:505, AssignAgentJobAsync ~:169) off DateTimeOffset.UtcNow onto _timeProvider.GetUtcNow() so the deadline origin (TakenAt/PolledAt/AssignedAt) is deterministic. Wire a FakeTimeProvider into WorkflowGrainFixture (mirroring AgentJobGrainFixture) so subsequent timeout specs can advance time. Do NOT implement the reminder/scan or the ledger here, and leave the heartbeat (runner-loss) time reads untouched per AC #5.
acceptanceCriteria: WorkflowOptions exists with SectionName="Mohist:Workflow" and WorkCompletionTimeout defaulting to 30min, registered in MohistServiceRegistration via Configure<WorkflowOptions>(configuration.GetSection(...)).
RunnerGrain constructor resolves TimeProvider and IOptions<WorkflowOptions> from DI; production still binds TimeProvider.System (MohistServiceRegistration.cs:77) so behavior is unchanged.
PollOneWorkflowAsync and AssignAgentJobAsync stamp the take time via _timeProvider.GetUtcNow(); no DateTimeOffset.UtcNow / DateTime.UtcNow at these two take points.
A spec advances WorkflowGrainFixture's FakeTimeProvider and observes that a taken work's recorded take time reflects the advanced fake clock (proving time is controllable).
Configuring WorkCompletionTimeout to a non-default value is observable through the bound options (spec scenario 统一超时不 per-task).
dotnet build (TreatWarningsAsErrors) and the full server test suite pass; existing runner-loss / heartbeat behavior is unchanged.
tasks.output: packages/server/src/Mohist.Server: WorkflowOptions.cs + MohistServiceRegistration registration + RunnerGrain constructor/time reads + WorkflowGrainFixture FakeTimeProvider wiring; green typecheck + tests.
tasks.notes: Design D5. TimeProvider.System is already a registered singleton (MohistServiceRegistration.cs:77); this is a constructor + DI change only. AgentJobGrain (AgentJobGrain.cs:42-46, AgentJobOptions.cs) is the pattern to mirror. Intentionally do NOT touch CheckHeartbeatAsync/_lastHeartbeat (runner-loss is a Non-Goal; AC #5 requires that path unchanged). RecoverActiveWorkflowWorkAsync's UtcNow reset is self-healed in T-002 once the ledger exists.

tasks.title: RunnerWorks 持久台账：统一记录 + EF 表 + store + take/report/activate 接入
tasks.description: Deliver the persistent per-runner work ledger as one cohesive module. Introduce a unified RunnerWork domain record (OwnerKind, OwnerId, WorkId, TakenAt, Status, Reason, FinishedAt) and refactor the in-memory _outstandingWorkflowWorks / _agentJobs into a unified active set backed by it. Add a RunnerWorkRow EF entity + MohistDbContext mapping (indexes on RunnerId + Status for the activation query) + a scoped RunnerWorkStore (IDbContextFactory<MohistDbContext>, mirroring WorkflowRunStore), plus an EF migration. Wire the lifecycle: insert a row (status=outstanding, TakenAt from TimeProvider) on take for BOTH owner kinds; hydrate the outstanding set once in OnActivateAsync via a filtered read (WHERE status='outstanding' AND runner_id); perform an authoritative update-to-terminal (completed|failed + Reason + FinishedAt, NO delete) in ReportWorkflowResultAsync (currently a pure relay) and the agent-job report path; reload the original TakenAt from the ledger in RecoverActiveWorkflowWorkAsync instead of UtcNow. History is retained (TTL is an explicit Non-Goal).
acceptanceCriteria: Taking a workflow or agent-job work inserts a RunnerWorks row with Status=outstanding, TakenAt from TimeProvider, OwnerKind, OwnerId, WorkId (spec 取用时插入台账行).
Report (success or synthesized failure) updates the row to completed/failed with Reason + FinishedAt and does NOT delete it; terminal rows never transition again (spec 终态更新不删除).
Status is flat outstanding|completed|failed; timeout/runner-lost appear only as Reason, no new status enum (spec 状态扁平失败原因入 Reason).

OnActivateAsync performs a single filtered read of outstanding rows into the in-memory active set; the reminder/tick path is not added here but the hydrate path is in place (spec 激活时 hydrate outstanding 集).
Agent-job work has its only ledger home in RunnerWorks; it is not expected in WorkflowRuns (spec agent-job work 在台账安家).
RecoverActiveWorkflowWorkAsync reloads the original TakenAt from the ledger and no longer overwrites it with UtcNow (spec RecoverActiveWorkflowWorkAsync 不重置时钟).
A recovery attempt (new workId) inserts a new row with its own TakenAt/deadline and inherits nothing from the prior failed row (spec 恢复 task 作为新 work 走新 deadline).
RunnerWorkStore is registered AddScoped in both MohistServiceRegistration (prod) and GrainTestConfig (test), mirroring RunnerDefinitionStore.
An EF migration for the RunnerWorks table is generated and applies cleanly on dev startup (Migrate).
dotnet build (TreatWarningsAsErrors) and server tests pass; specs assert take-insert, terminal-update-no-delete, activate-hydrate, and agent-job-has-home using FakeTimeProvider for TakenAt.
tasks.output: packages/server/src/Mohist.Server: RunnerWork record + RunnerWorkRow.cs + RunnerWorkStore.cs + MohistDbContext mapping + EF migration + RunnerGrain ledger integration (take/activate/report/recover); green typecheck + tests.
tasks.notes: Design D1 (EF table, NOT [PersistentState] — filtered read avoids loading unbounded history on activation) and D3 (unified record, both owner kinds). RunnerWorkRow/RunnerWorkStore mirror WorkflowRunRow/WorkflowRunStore and RunnerRow/AddRunnerDefinitionTable. Report's terminal ledger update becomes the authoritative status source that T-003's synthesis reconfirms against (D4). The WorkKey shape ("{ownerKind}\u001f{ownerId}\u001f{workId}", RunnerGrain.cs:568) is the natural (RunnerId x WorkKey) identity for the row.

tasks.title: Work 完成超时检测：持久 reminder + 内存扫描 + 合成失败 + 测试钩子
tasks.spec: specs/workflow-supervision/spec.md#Work 完成超时检测由持久 reminder 驱动
tasks.description: Deliver the actual timeout safety net. Make RunnerGrain implement IRemindable and register a per-runner Orleans reminder (e.g. "work-timeout") via RegisterOrUpdateReminder on take, unregistering it once the outstanding set drains (lazy lifecycle so a quiesced grain can stay deactivated). ReceiveReminder and a public CheckWorkTimeoutsAsync() test hook (mirroring AgentJobGrain.CheckTimeoutsAsync) call the same private scan that iterates ONLY the in-memory active set (zero DB reads per tick); when now - TakenAt > WorkCompletionTimeout, synthesize WorkResult("failed","timeout") through the existing ReportWorkflowResultAsync channel (workflow) and the agent-job fail channel, branching by OwnerKind. Because the reminder re-activates the grain, OnActivateAsync hydrates before ReceiveReminder fires. Under [Reentrant], snapshot keys and reconfirm each entry is still outstanding (in memory AND ledger) before synthesizing; the report terminal update from T-002 is authoritative so timeout and runner-loss never double-synthesize. Extend the runner-loss synthesis (NotifyTrackedWorkflowRunnersLostAsync) over the unified set so agent-job works are also drained on runner loss, and apply the same reconfirm guard there.
acceptanceCriteria: RunnerGrain implements IRemindable and registers a per-runner Orleans reminder persisted in OrleansRemindersTable (RegisterOrUpdateReminder on take; unregistered when the outstanding set empties); it does NOT use a grain timer for work-completion supervision (spec 使用持久 reminder 而非 grain timer).
A reminder tick iterates only the in-memory active set and performs no DB reads (spec 扫描零 DB 读).

A work outstanding beyond WorkCompletionTimeout is synthesized as WorkResult(status="failed", reason="timeout") via ReportWorkflowResultAsync; no new result state is introduced (spec RunnerGrain 控制面安全网兜底; 统一超时不 per-task).

After server+runner sync restart (grain deactivated, time advanced past timeout, grain reactivated), the reminder fires, the orphaned outstanding work (hydrated on activation) is detected and synthesized as failed(timeout) — covers issue #275 (spec 跨重启检测孤儿 work).
Under [Reentrant] concurrent report, the scan snapshots keys and reconfirms outstanding status before synthesizing; a work already reported terminal is not re-synthesized (spec Reentrant 下扫描与合成的一致性).
A work synthesized failed(timeout) is not re-synthesized by a subsequent runner-loss scan, and vice-versa (spec 超时与 runner-loss 合成互不干扰).

Runner-loss (NotifyTrackedWorkflowRunnersLostAsync) drains BOTH workflow and agent-job outstanding works over the unified set; WorkflowGrain receives a result indistinguishable from a normal failure (spec runner 丢失触发合成失败).

IRunnerGrain exposes CheckWorkTimeoutsAsync(); a spec advances FakeTimeProvider past WorkCompletionTimeout, invokes the hook, and deterministically asserts timeout synthesis / non-synthesis (spec 测试用 FakeTimeProvider 确定性验证).
The previously-skipped RunnerFailureSpecs.RunningTask_WithoutReport_TimesOutWithoutQueryingRunner is un-skipped/replaced with FakeTimeProvider-based coverage at the RunnerGrain layer.
dotnet build (TreatWarningsAsErrors) and the full server test suite pass; existing heartbeat-timer runner-loss detection behavior is otherwise unchanged (AC #5).
tasks.output: packages/server/src/Mohist.Server: RunnerGrain IRemindable + reminder lifecycle + scan/synthesis + CheckWorkTimeoutsAsync hook + runner-loss agent-job drain; packages/server/tests: timeout/restart/non-interference specs (FakeTimeProvider); green typecheck + tests.
tasks.notes: Design D2 (per-runner reminder, lazy register-on-take/unregister-on-drain), D4 (reentrancy: snapshot + reconfirm, terminal update authoritative), D6 (CheckWorkTimeoutsAsync test hook). Test silo uses UseInMemoryReminderService (GrainTestConfig.cs:42) so reminders are not deterministically tickable — the manual hook gives deterministic assertions, exactly like AgentJobGrainSpecs. Open Question to resolve during implementation: confirm the exact IAgentJobGrain synthesized-fail hook for agent-job timeout/runner-loss (AgentJobGrain already has timeout failure reasons via its own CheckTimeoutsAsync); add a small hook if absent. Confirm the Orleans reminder minimum-period floor and finalize the ~1min scan period. now is read via _timeProvider.GetUtcNow() (T-001).
